{"inserts": ["INSERT INTO public.users (id, email, name, country, status, created_at) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 'u1@example.com', 'User One', 'US', 'active', '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz), (2, 'u2@example.com', NULL, 'CA', 'inactive', '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz)", "INSERT INTO public.orders (id, user_id, status, total_cents, created_at, updated_at) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', 1000, $3, $3), (2, 1, 'paid', 1000, '1900-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz, '1900-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz), (3, 2, 'pending', 500, '9999-12-31 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz, '9999-12-31 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz)", "INSERT INTO public.products (id, sku, name, category, price_cents) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 'SKU-1', 'Match exact boundary', $1, 100), (2, 'SKU-2', 'Only old order', $1, 100), (3, 'SKU-3', 'Only low quantity', $1, 100), (4, 'SKU-4', 'Wrong category', $1 || '_x', 100), (5, 'SKU-5', 'Duplicate matches', $1, 100), (6, 'SKU-6', 'No line items', $1, 100), (7, 'SKU-7', 'Case variant category', upper($1) || 'q', 100), (8, 'SKU-8', 'Future order match', $1, 100)", "INSERT INTO public.line_items (id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 1, 1, $4, 100), (2, 2, 2, $4, 100), (3, 1, 3, $4 - 1, 100), (4, 1, 4, $4, 100), (5, 1, 5, $4, 100), (6, 3, 5, $4, 100), (7, 1, 5, $4, 100), (8, 1, 7, $4, 100), (9, 3, 8, $4, 100), (10, 2, 8, $4 - 1, 100)"]}
